name: operator-context
description: Gives Claude the facts you keep in a short profile file: who you are, what you own, what you authorize. Added once per session, framed as facts that never override safety rules; lines that try to switch safety off are dropped and shown. /operator shows it.

profileFile.title: Profile file
profileFile.description: The file with your facts and authorizations. ~ is your home folder. No file means nothing is added.

subagents.title: Give the profile to subagents
subagents.description: Also put the profile at the top of each subagent's task, since their system prompt comes from their agent definition.
